context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 51 verified card view modes and long-press preview. Key findings: 1) Profile Cards Tab: 3 view mode buttons (compact/grid/list) with data-testid='profile-view-compact' for compact. Cards use data-testid='profile-compact-card-<id>', 'profile-grid-card-<id>', 'profile-list-card-<id>'. 2) Feed Explore Tab: 3 view mode buttons with data-testid='view-compact', 'view-grid', 'view-list'. Cards use data-testid='compact-card-<id>', 'grid-card-<id>', 'list-card-<id>'. 3) Long-press (500ms+) triggers CardPreviewModal with data-testid='card-preview-overlay' and 'card-preview-modal'. 4) Short click (<500ms) navigates to /c/<cardId>. 5) Eye/View button removed from cards. 6) PictureInPicture (data-testid='pip-player') only renders when minimizedItems contains reel/live with videoUrl - not testable without video data.

profile_view_modes.details: 3 view mode buttons found (compact/grid/list). Compact shows 3-column grid, Grid shows 2-column grid, List shows rows. All with correct data-testid attributes.

feed_view_modes.details: 3 view mode buttons found (data-testid=view-compact, view-grid, view-list). Compact shows 3-column grid (10 cards), Grid shows 2-column grid (10 cards), List shows rows (10 cards).

card_click_navigation.details: Short click (<500ms) on card navigates to /c/<cardId>. Tested on both Profile and Feed pages.

long_press_preview_modal.details: Long-press (>500ms) triggers CardPreviewModal with card info, Abrir button (data-testid=preview-open-btn), and Share button. Tested on both Profile and Feed pages.

eye_view_button_removed.details: No Eye/View button found on cards. Cards are now clickable directly.

picture_in_picture.details: PictureInPicture component exists in App.js (line 159) with data-testid='pip-player'. Only renders when minimizedItems contains reel/live with videoUrl. Not testable without video data.

card_preview_modal_buttons.details: CardPreviewModal shows Abrir button (navigates to card) and Share button (uses navigator.share API)
